nurse.text: Hello there. Georgetown Hospital, which we call the Sanctuary for creatures. The sea air will do your team a world of good. Pop them on the counter.
What can we do for you?

then.text: The water is boiled and the tea is brewed. A little rest never hurt anyone, even on an island where the rest is mostly a turtle's business.
All done. They look as good as a freshly hatched turtle heading for the sea.
The Ark's in the corner, next to the ledger of who owes whom a pint.

else.text: No worries. The goats will keep you company.
